claims.content: The goal is to securely remove files and folders from disk, avoiding possible data recovery.

goal.raw_text: The goal is to securely remove files and folders from disk, avoiding possible data recovery.

claims.content: User
The user can access PeaZip's file management tools from the initial window of the application (file manager interface).
Secure file deletion is available as a file management utility intended for securely removing files and folders from disk, avoiding possible data recovery.
When using File Tools while browsing the file system, Secure delete is listed for files only.
The use case is triggered when the User selects Secure delete (files only) from File Tools while browsing the file system.

trigger.raw_text: The use case is triggered when the User selects Secure delete (files only) from File Tools while browsing the file system.

claims.content: PeaZip offers access to a series of file management tools from the initial window of the application (file manager interface).
While browsing the file system, the User selects Secure delete (files only) from File Tools (Shift+Del).
Secure file deletion is implemented by multiple successive passes of the deletion procedure over the storage area of the selected for deletion file.
After the end of the procedure of secure deletion, no data remains from data that have been selected to be securely deleted in the storing area of the computer system.

1. At main flow step 1, the series of file management tools, including secure file deletion, may be accessed from the create archive window(create archive interface) and extraction window(extraction interface), in addition to the initial window of the application (file manager interface).
2. At main flow step 2, secure file and archive deletion may be performed from any storing unit of the computer system on which PeaZip runs.

1. If the User invokes Secure delete (files only) from File Tools while the selected object is not a file, the command is limited to files and cannot perform secure deletion for that selected object; the use case exits without executing secure deletion through this command.
No data remains from data that have been selected to be securely deleted is left in the storing area of the computer system after the end of the procedure of secure deletion.
Files and folders are securely removed from disk, avoiding possible data recovery.
